Package com.sca4d.web.realtime.connection

Class LocalConnectionRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.web.realtime.connection.LocalConnectionRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
@Internal public final class LocalConnectionRegistry extends Object implements AutoCloseable
保存当前节点的实际连接句柄，并定时续租对应 Redis 共享索引。
